paragraphs: A full-stack platform that streamlines the procurement and distribution of standardized school uniforms by connecting parents, schools, and approved vendors. The project pairs a Django REST backend with a modern React/Vite frontend to deliver secure authentication, catalog discovery, vendor lifecycle management, and cart-to-order workflows.
features: Custom user model enforcing email-based login and role helpers.
Uniform specs derive from schools.School and expose vendor listings via serializer SerializerMethodField.
Ops/staff approvals toggle both vendor status and associated user role.
